#   lock, nextTickTime (compared with System.currentTimeMillis, += 33), readerThread, world,
# GameServer: world, sessions (one slot per player), pendingCommands (queued for local execution),
#   commandsToApply (the drained copy), matchRecord, serverSocket, clients, state, lock, startTime
#   (base of the mm:ss log stamp), tickThread, acceptThread.
# ServerClientSession: server, socket, reader, writer, playerName, ready (READY opcode),
#   playing (STATUS flag), pendingMessages (what send() appends to), sendBatch (the writer thread's
#   working copy; ClientWriterThread clears it, copies pendingMessages in, then writes each element).
